Fire Magic Overview
Fire Magic
is a common magical combat skill learned by many across
Alharth
.
In-Game Description
Using Fire to destroy your enemies. This is a very potent offensive skill, including long-range and area-effect attacks, and even some Cold attacks for versatility. However, there are drawbacks: Fire Magic is extremely Power-intensive; all creatures generate extra Rage when they are burned; and many creatures have some resistance to fire.
Training Fire Magic
Velkort
, an elf living in
Serbule
, is always willing to teach
Fire Magic
to interested travelers.
The Sand Seer
, a Rakshasa in
Ilmari
, unlocks levels 51-70 and teaches equivalent level recipes.
Landri the Cold
is willing to teach Defensive Chill to
Fire Mages
.
Bendith the Banished
unlocks levels 71-80 and teaches the equivalent recipes.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Reinath
deep beneath
Povus
.

Fire Magic Mechanics
Fire Magic
is completely useless underwater!
Research Ingredients
Fire Magic
is a research based magic, and abilities are unlocked through combining specific ingredients using recipes. The skill can be expensive due to the required ingredients used in spell research:
Fire Dust
,
Sulfur
,
Saltpeter
,
Explosive Runestone
.
Flame Nib
,
Guano
,
Phoenix Beak
,
Phoenix Feather
,
Phoenix Egg
. Please see the pages for those ingredients for more information on how to gather them. Researching is
not
a lottery, each recipe can only be completed a number of times so the amount of ingredients required is fixed. The research mechanic simply adds a little randomness to the order in which you receive the abilities.
The abilities
Spontaneous Fireball
and
Spontaneous Warmthball
are not classified as
Fire Magic
abilities, but can be learned when completing the appropriate level research recipes.
Fire Wall
An interesting mechanic is that
Fire Magic
has a “Fire Wall” pet that just stands around and burns things. It’s implemented as a pet internally, but since it’s a wall, it can’t follow you around. It’s more like a trap. It can also be killed by enemies.
Weapons
Not all staffs are produced with the proper runes to handle the use of magic. Casting
Fire Magic
requires the use of a
Fire Staff
.
